input.overview: Blood Bank Billiards is a five-ball modern-EM game with two related scoring boards. Complete the 14 object-ball shots to light the gobble hole for the 8-ball and reset the rack. Each object ball also activates its matching Blood Bank target, where draining the eight flashing front targets awards an Extra Ball.
input.simpleOverview: Complete all 14 object-ball shots, then shoot the lit gobble hole for the 8-ball and a new rack. Never shoot that hole early: an unlit gobble hole is a scratch and ends the ball.
input.summary: Complete the two drop-target banks and eight rear standups that represent the 14 object balls. After all 14 are complete, shoot the lit gobble hole for the 8-ball, 2,250 points, and a fresh rack; avoid the gobble hole while it is unlit because that scratch ends the ball.

quickInfo.name: Object balls
quickInfo.summary: The two drop banks and eight rear standups represent the 14 solids and stripes. The inlanes spot the 7 and 9 balls.

quickInfo.name: 8-ball
quickInfo.summary: Completing all 14 object balls lights the gobble hole; the lit collect scores 2,250 and resets the rack.

quickInfo.name: Scratch
quickInfo.summary: Shooting the gobble hole before the 8-ball is lit ends the current ball.

quickInfo.name: Blood Bank
quickInfo.summary: Object balls activate corresponding Blood Bank targets. Drain the eight flashing front targets to award an Extra Ball.

steps.text: Shoot the two drop-target banks and eight rear standups to complete the 14 object balls; the inlanes can spot the 7 and 9 balls.
Stay out of the gobble hole while it is unlit because an early shot is a scratch and ends the current ball.
After all 14 object balls are complete, shoot the lit gobble hole for the 8-ball, 2,250 points, and a reset rack.
Repeat the object-ball and lit-8-ball sequence for another rack.
Complete object-ball shots to activate their matching Blood Bank targets; as many as two can flash for 300 points.
Hit the eight flashing front Blood Bank targets to drain them of blood.
Drain all eight active front targets to award an Extra Ball while continuing the rack route separately.

playfieldReferences.label: 8-ball / scratch hole
playfieldReferences.description: The central gobble hole that collects a lit 8-ball or ends the ball as an unlit scratch.

playfieldReferences.label: Extra Ball Blood Bank targets
playfieldReferences.description: The eight front targets that must be drained while flashing for the Extra Ball award.

cautions.issue: Blood Bank Billiards is software for the Drained P3 module, not a separate physical game kit.
cautions.response: Select the Blood Bank Billiards app on a P3 fitted with the Drained module before play.

cautions.issue: Ball count and Extra Ball behavior are operator-adjustable.
cautions.response: The factory setup uses five balls and playable Extra Balls; check the machine's displayed settings if your location differs.
